title: ITC Club Membership Terms
content:
# ITC Club Membership Terms

**Version:** October 27, 2026

# Membership summary

- **Price:** US$4.99 per month. Final price, with no additional taxes on the membership fee.
- **Renewal:** Automatic each month until canceled.
- **Cancellation:** At any time. Access continues until the current period ends.
- **Refunds:** No discretionary refunds; statutory rights remain unaffected.
- **Benefits:** Access to all Club benefits, subject to each offer's conditions.
- **Free trials:** By invitation only, subject to the conditions disclosed before activation.

Read the summary above together with the full terms below.

# 1. Operator, acceptance, and personal accounts

ITC Club membership is offered by Eventland LLC, a limited liability company organized under the laws of New Jersey, United States ("ITC," "Eventland," "we," "us," or "our"). These Terms govern subscribing to, paying for, renewing, canceling, and using the membership and are presented for your acceptance before you subscribe.

To subscribe, you must be at least 18 years old, have reached the age of majority in your jurisdiction, and have the legal capacity to enter into a contract. Membership is linked to a personal account and is nontransferable. It may not be sold, lent, or shared to allow another person to use its benefits independently.

These Terms supplement the general Terms and Conditions for Insight The City and ITC Club. A promotion's specific conditions govern that promotion, and each benefit's conditions govern its redemption. No document may eliminate consumer rights established by law.

# 2. What membership includes

Payment of the membership fee provides access to **all benefits available and included in ITC Club** while your membership is active. Each benefit has its own conditions, which you should review before activating it, making a reservation, or making a purchase.

**Yorki is available as a free feature and does not require a paid ITC Club membership.** Its account and separate-consent requirements are described in the general Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.

Access to the entire catalog does not mean that every benefit can be used without limits. Offers may specify how often a benefit can be used, dates, hours, capacity limits, minimum spending, advance reservations, included products, guest conditions, and rules on combining promotions.

The membership fee does not automatically cover admission tickets, food, products, experiences, or services provided by participating businesses. You pay the provider any applicable amount after the benefit is applied, unless the offer expressly states that an item is included or free. Membership does not guarantee a particular amount of savings.

# 3. Price and payment processing

The monthly membership has a final price of **US$4.99 per month**, expressed in United States dollars. ITC does not add taxes or other charges to this fee. Purchases made directly from a participating business are subject to the final price and charges disclosed by that business.

Membership payments are processed through Stripe. You must provide a valid payment method that you are authorized to use and keep its details up to date. Activating a paid membership requires the corresponding payment to be completed and verifiable. Free trials are governed by Section 5.

When available at checkout, you may choose Link, Stripe's service for saving and reusing payment information. **Using Link is optional** and is governed by the provider's applicable terms and privacy notice presented for that service. Your choice to use Link is separate from your authorization of the ITC Club subscription and recurring charges. The Privacy Policy explains the contact, billing, and payment information that Stripe or Link may make available to ITC.

The membership period, next billing date, and amount are disclosed when you subscribe and in your subscription confirmation. A billing month does not necessarily equal 30 days. The standard plan does not include a free trial unless you have received and activated a valid promotional invitation.

# 4. Automatic renewal and payment authorization

Membership **renews automatically each month for US$4.99** until you cancel automatic renewal, subject to the authorization you provide when subscribing. There is no minimum commitment beyond the current monthly period.

Before requesting your payment information and consent, we will clearly disclose the price, billing frequency, date or deadline for avoiding the next charge, and cancellation method. If a promotion applies, we will also explain its duration and the price that follows.

The subscription and recurring charges require your express consent. Creating an account, receiving an invitation, accepting the Privacy Policy, or entering payment details does not replace that authorization. After subscribing, you will receive a confirmation you can retain containing the terms, charges, and cancellation instructions.

To avoid the next charge, you must cancel **before the renewal date and time** specified for your subscription. No additional advance notice of several days is required. Price changes are governed by Section 13.

# 5. Free trials and invitation-only promotions

ITC may offer free trials to selected users through promotional invitations. ITC determines who receives each invitation and the promotion's conditions. A free trial is not a general benefit for all users and does not create a right to future invitations.

Before you activate a trial, we will disclose its duration, eligibility requirements, any deadline for using the invitation, the first billing date, the subsequent price, and how to cancel. A 30-day trial applies only when the invitation expressly offers it. **The trial period begins when you activate the promotional membership**, not when you receive the email or invitation.

Activating a trial linked to the monthly subscription requires a valid payment method and express authorization for subsequent renewal. At the end of the trial, you will be charged US$4.99, and membership will continue to renew monthly unless you cancel before the first charge. If you cancel during the trial, **you will retain access until the granted free period ends**.

Eligibility requirements and any limits on repeat use will be those stated in the invitation. The conditions of an activated trial will be honored throughout the granted period. For trials longer than one month, we will send a reminder with cancellation instructions between 3 and 21 days before the deadline for avoiding the first charge, in addition to any other legally required notice.

# 6. Declined, unverified, or pending payments

A problem collecting or verifying a renewal payment does not shorten an existing membership period. You retain access until that period expires.

If, **when the current period ends**, the system cannot verify the renewal payment, **access to benefits requiring membership is suspended**. The suspension remains in place until you provide a valid payment method and **the corresponding payment is completed and verified**. Adding a card without completing the payment does not reactivate membership.

Suspension does not extend the previous period or replace cancellation of automatic renewal. You may cancel automatic renewal even while benefits are suspended. Any payment collected to restore membership must correspond to the disclosed amount and period and a valid payment authorization; you will not be charged twice for the same period.

If you believe a payment has been completed but your access has not been updated, you may email ITCClub@insightthecity.com so we can review its status. Do not send full card numbers, security codes, or passwords.

# 7. Cancellation and access through the end of the period

You may cancel automatic renewal at any time using the subscription cancellation option available in the app. Cancellation will be straightforward and available through the same digital channels used to subscribe, without requiring a phone call or contact with support as a mandatory step.

Cancellation stops future renewals and does not end the current period early: you may continue using benefits until it expires, subject to each offer's conditions. The same applies to a free trial canceled before the first charge. Your cancellation confirmation will state the date your access ends.

Canceling membership does not delete your account. When the period expires, you may continue using the available free features and decide later whether to subscribe again. Reactivating a canceled subscription requires the corresponding action and renewal authorization.

Uninstalling the app, signing out, or stopping use of benefits does not cancel your subscription. If the cancellation option produces an error, contact us so we can resolve it; a system failure does not justify delaying a timely cancellation request or retaining improper charges.

# 8. Refund policy

ITC **does not offer discretionary refunds** for canceling membership, not using benefits, or using only some of them. Cancellation does not result in a prorated refund for the days remaining in the current period, during which you may continue using membership.

Billing errors will be reviewed and corrected, including refunds of duplicate or unauthorized charges or charges made after a timely cancellation, as appropriate. This policy also does not exclude refunds or other remedies arising from ITC's failure to fulfill its obligations or provided by law.

You may report a billing issue to ITCClub@insightthecity.com. Assistance from support does not replace or condition your right to raise a claim with your payment provider, a government authority, or a court with jurisdiction.

# 9. Redemption conditions and QR codes

To redeem a benefit, you must have an active membership and meet the published conditions for that offer. Relevant restrictions will be displayed before activation or redemption. A benefit may be combined with other promotions only when its conditions allow it.

**QR codes expire 24 hours after activation**. How often a code may be activated and the number of permitted redemptions depend on each benefit. A QR code may not be used if it has expired, been altered or transferred, or reached its redemption limit.

Activating a QR code does not make a reservation, purchase a ticket, or guarantee availability. It also does not extend membership: your membership must remain active when you redeem the benefit, even if the QR code is less than 24 hours old. Guests or family members may be included only when the offer expressly allows it and within its conditions.

If an ITC system failure prevents use of a valid code or a participating business rejects a benefit despite its conditions being met, contact support. ITC will review the issue and arrange the appropriate correction regarding its own commitments. QR code rules do not eliminate your rights if ITC fails to fulfill its obligations.

# 10. Participating businesses' products and services

Eventland sells and administers membership. Participating businesses sell and provide their own products and services and manage their prices, reservations, changes, cancellations, delivery, and refunds in accordance with their disclosed conditions and the law.

Before making a purchase, review the final amount, what the benefit includes, and the business's conditions. The ITC Club membership fee and the price of a purchase from a participating business are separate charges. A dispute about that purchase does not automatically result in a refund of the membership fee.

ITC remains responsible for its own acts, omissions, and commitments regarding membership and the operation of benefits. A participating business's independence does not constitute a general release of Eventland from liability.

# 11. Availability and catalog changes

The catalog may add, update, or remove participating businesses and offers. Each benefit is subject to its disclosed availability conditions. ITC does not promise that an offer or participating business will remain available indefinitely unless we expressly commit to this when you subscribe.

Changes may not retroactively alter an already confirmed purchase or reservation. They also do not authorize withdrawal of a service or benefit expressly promised as part of a paid membership. If a change or interruption materially prevents use of the service you subscribed to, ITC will review the appropriate solution, including remedies provided by law.

# 12. Misuse, suspension, and account deletion

ITC may take proportionate measures in response to fraud, unauthorized transfers of benefits, manipulation of redemptions, security risks, or serious or repeated violations. Unless there is an urgent security issue or a legal restriction, we will explain the reason and provide a way to request review. A legitimate complaint or an honest negative opinion does not justify suspension.

Suspension for misuse is separate from suspension for nonpayment described in Section 6. Neither eliminates your rights regarding improper charges or ITC's failure to fulfill its obligations.

You may initiate account deletion in the app, which also cancels the associated subscription to stop future renewals. Deleting your account ends access to benefits that require it, even if time remains in the current period. To retain that time, cancel only automatic renewal and keep your account. Deletion does not, by itself, result in a refund or extinguish rights provided by law.

# 13. Changes, pricing, and communications

ITC will publish updated versions of these Terms and communicate material changes before they take effect. Changes will not retroactively alter periods already paid for or trials already granted.

Material changes to the offer, including price changes, will be communicated at least 5 business days and no more than 30 days in advance, subject to any additional legal requirements. Before charging an existing subscriber a higher price, ITC will request express consent. If you do not accept, the increased price will not be charged, and we will explain the effect on your next renewal; access will continue until the current period expires.

Continuing to use the app or accepting a new version of its general terms does not, by itself, authorize new charges. Necessary communications about payments, membership periods, cancellation, or contractual changes are separate from promotional messages. Membership does not require you to accept advertising. It does not replace the specific permissions or consents described in the Privacy Policy.

# 14. Support, governing law, and consumer rights

Operator: Eventland LLC. Service: ITC Club membership offered through Insight The City. Email for questions, billing issues, and complaints: ITCClub@insightthecity.com.

These Terms are governed by the laws of New Jersey, without overriding mandatory consumer protections or applicable rules on jurisdiction and venue, including those of New York where applicable.

Seeking assistance directly from ITC is voluntary and does not prevent you from contacting government authorities or courts. These Terms do not impose mandatory arbitration or class action waivers, exclude liability for fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, or other harm for which liability cannot lawfully be excluded, or limit consumers' legal remedies.

The handling of personal information associated with membership and redemptions is explained in the Privacy Policy available in the app. Payment authorization and consent to the use of personal information are managed separately.
